events.title: Hurricanes vs. Senators
events.blurb: The Carolina Hurricanes host the Ottawa Senators on Saturday night.
events.blurbEs: Los Carolina Hurricanes reciben a los Ottawa Senators el sábado por la noche.

events.title: NC Symphony: Cirque Holiday Pops
events.blurb: The North Carolina Symphony pairs holiday classics with acrobatics over Thanksgiving weekend. Santa is available to meet before the show; children 2 and under are not admitted.
events.blurbEs: La North Carolina Symphony combina clásicos navideños con acrobacias durante el fin de semana de Acción de Gracias. Santa recibe al público antes del concierto; no se admiten niños de 2 años o menos.
events.getThere: The two lots in front of the venue closed permanently; the venue recommends downtown decks such as Performing Arts (128 W. South St.) or Convention Center (1 W. Lenoir St.). City Center Red Hat and Moore Square decks are free nights and weekends.

events.title: A Motown Christmas
events.blurb: The Motortown All-Stars, singers from the Miracles, the Contours and other Motown acts, perform Motown hits and holiday songs with a live band. Doors open at 2 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Los Motortown All-Stars, cantantes de the Miracles, the Contours y otros grupos de Motown, interpretan éxitos de Motown y canciones navideñas con banda en vivo. Las puertas abren a las 2 p.m.
events.getThere: The two lots in front of the venue closed permanently; the venue recommends downtown decks such as Performing Arts (128 W. South St.) or Convention Center (1 W. Lenoir St.). City Center Red Hat and Moore Square decks are free nights and weekends.

events.title: North Carolina Chinese Lantern Festival
events.blurb: The 11th annual lantern festival fills the amphitheatre grounds with illuminated displays and stage performances. Runs nightly through Jan. 10; last entry 9 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La 11.ª edición del festival de faroles llena el anfiteatro con figuras iluminadas y espectáculos en escenario. Abre todas las noches hasta el 10 de enero; última entrada a las 9 p.m.
events.getThere: About 1,500 free parking spaces; preferred parking passes are sold separately.

events.title: FestiBull of Lights
events.blurb: A walk-through holiday light show synced to music at the Durham Bulls' ballpark, with Santa, crafts and s'mores. A holiday train ride is a $5 add-on.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido de luces navideñas sincronizadas con música en el estadio de los Durham Bulls, con Santa, manualidades y s'mores. El paseo en tren navideño cuesta $5 adicionales.

events.title: UNC vs. NC State Football
events.blurb: North Carolina hosts NC State in the rivalry's regular-season finale, which is also UNC's Senior Day. Broadcast on ACC Network.
events.blurbEs: North Carolina recibe a NC State en el cierre de la temporada regular de esta rivalidad, que también es el Senior Day de UNC. Se transmite por ACC Network.

events.title: Christmas Carousel Holiday Gift Market
events.venue: Jim Graham Building, NC State Fairgrounds
events.blurb: A three-day holiday gift market at the State Fairgrounds over Thanksgiving weekend.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño de regalos de tres días en el recinto de la feria estatal durante el fin de semana de Acción de Gracias.

events.title: Free Public Tour at NCMA
events.venue: North Carolina Museum of Art (West Building)
events.blurb: An hour-long public tour of the museum's galleries. Admission to the permanent collection and Museum Park is free.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido público de una hora por las galerías del museo. La entrada a la colección permanente y al Museum Park es gratuita.
events.getThere: Free visitor parking in the Blue Ridge lots off Museum Drive; GoRaleigh route 27L Blue Ridge serves the museum.

events.title: Museum Store Sunday at NCMA
events.venue: North Carolina Museum of Art (West Building)
events.blurb: The museum store marks Museum Store Sunday during regular museum hours. Entry to the museum's permanent collection is free.
events.blurbEs: La tienda del museo celebra el Museum Store Sunday durante el horario habitual. La entrada a la colección permanente del museo es gratuita.
events.getThere: Free visitor parking in the Blue Ridge lots off Museum Drive; GoRaleigh route 27L Blue Ridge serves the museum.
